repowise.description:
Primary code-navigation surface for all SoleMD code: one workspace server with a `repo=` argument (repos: `infra` [default], `graph`, `make`, `web`, and `repowise` for self-inspection; `repo="all"` fans out federated reads over the four product repos; `list_repos` is discovery). The `repowise` alias indexes the engine source for navigation, is scoped-only (`federated: false` in the workspace file, so it never joins `all`), and may legitimately have no decision journal.

Choose the next read from the question: `search_codebase(query, repo=...)` locates an owner; `get_context(targets=[files], include=["skeleton"])` or Read covers a file; `get_symbol(path.py::Name)` retrieves a specific body already named by evidence. Do not walk a file symbol by symbol. On search rows `target_path` is the file; the symbol is `symbol_path` (source-lane rows, including nested `Outer::inner`) or `symbol_id` (native indexed-symbol rows). Never feed `target_path` alone to `get_symbol`. Path-like `get_context` targets stay in the file namespace: a missing, excluded, or unindexed path must say so and never fall through to an unrelated symbol; use `path::Symbol` for explicit symbol intent.

Explicit `mode="symbol"` / `mode="path"` and explicit `kind`, `symbol_kind`, or `page_type` filters use the native indexed resolvers. An exact miss must not become a semantic guess. Everything else, including a bare identifier in the default auto mode, uses the source-and-wiki retrieval lane, whose exact-identifier router serves the owner claim; do not require its confidence or dense-evidence fields on native lookup responses.

Verbose natural-language queries are served whole. Result rows carry evidence (`dense_cosine`, `lexical_rank`, `exact_name`, `lane`), confidence (`confident` / `caution` / `no_match`), `selected_owner {file, reason}`, and `symbol_path` / `contains_symbols`.

Orientation: `get_overview` (once per unfamiliar repo), `get_architecture` (workspace layers/communities), `get_index_status` (trust verdict and working tree; `mode="path"` for one file), `get_health`, `get_dead_code`, and `get_query_quality`. `get_dependency_path` answers call-path questions; `get_dependents` gives complete inbound totals with honest pagination. Before a risky edit, pair `get_change_risk` with `get_blast_radius`; `get_risk` PR mode leads with `may_break`, `missing_cochanges`, and `tests_to_run` (`tests_to_run_basis="measured"` is proven linkage; `"inferred"` is naming-only). `get_reference_sites` takes a symbol name, not a path; `preview_symbol_rename` previews its sites. An empty `callers`, `callees`, or `used_by` list carries a `*_basis` object (language, resolved call edges, guessed share): it means "no resolved edge", never proof that none exist. Use `get_execution_flows` for entry paths. Use `build_task_slice`, `get_task_slice`, and `extend_task_slice` when one work package beats serial probes; an exact symbol seed stays exact, and callers/tests/downstream paths outrank sibling definitions. Use `find_clones` and `find_patterns` before adding parallel code.

Natural-language `get_why` returns one strongest decision, compact `candidate_decisions`, and structured expansion handles. Resolve one ruling with `id=`; request the broader documentation, episodes, target context, lineage, and secondary bodies only with `include=["supporting"]`. `get_why` and `manage_decision` read a registered repo's git-tracked journal when present (`<repo>/.repowise/decisions.jsonl`, selected by `repo=`, default `infra`). `journal_exists:false` means no journal file, not zero decisions. Record only durable, non-obvious rationale that constrains future work; routine implementation details do not need proposals. `manage_decision(action="record", repo=..., actor=...)` lands proposed and may create the journal. Under Jon's standing engineering delegation, agents decide and confirm verified internal technical choices within an already authorized task and its agreed constraints; use `/repowise`'s decision lifecycle for scope and candidate upkeep. Bring Jon material unresolved product choices or departures requiring authority not already granted. Ratification still requires `action="confirm"`; name the actual actor and delegated authority. Only `confirmed_at` grants journal authority: committing the diff preserves the record but does not ratify it, and an unconfirmed `status:"active"` remains a candidate. Every write names one repo; workspace-wide SoleMD rules live in `infra`'s journal.

Wire shape: `structuredContent` is the flat tool payload, with no `{result: ...}` wrapper; the text block mirrors it. Read the payload's compact `trust` block for staleness, retrieval degradation, source read generation, working-tree verification, and unavailable workspace members. `generation_id` names the reader; `published_generation_id` names the latest publication. A mismatch is stale, not current, and `working_tree.checked:false` means unverified. The full diagnostic envelope remains in protocol `_meta`, which some agent connectors omit. The served surface intentionally excludes generative synthesis; every exposed retrieval tool must give self-contained next steps.

The embedder is `embeddinggemma` on the llama.cpp model server (`llama-server.service`, 127.0.0.1:8090), which is host-native and normally always on (`systemctl --user status llama-server`, `curl http://127.0.0.1:8090/health`). When it is down, search serves FTS-only and recovers per request after the server returns. Do not infer that the dense lane ran merely from `embedder_degraded:false`; inspect result evidence and `trust`. RepoWise is a systemd user unit; if unreachable, run `systemctl --user restart repowise-mcp`. Native `repowise watch --workspace --index-only` runs continuously in `repowise-watch.service`: saved changes trigger indexing automatically, including uncommitted edits. Keep it enabled and running; gaming mode or deliberate maintenance may pause it. Startup and the ten-minute `repowise-update.timer` reconcile missed events and pending publication through native locks; the timer alone refreshes the template wiki pages, so those can trail saved edits by up to ten minutes. `solemd doctor` checks the watcher separately from MCP health and index freshness. RepoWise also serves indexed external documentation through its optional docs worker. The dashboard at `/docs-libraries` is the canonical library and document inventory.

Documentation uses this same RepoWise server: `resolve_library_id` identifies a source; `list_doc_files` browses indexed files with path filtering and exact pagination; `search_docs` retrieves passages (`library_ids` spans sources); `read_doc` and `expand_doc_chunk` open the supporting text. `list_doc_libraries` reports coverage and freshness. `add_doc_library`, `update_doc_library`, `delete_doc_library`, `export_doc_bundle`, and `import_doc_bundle` manage the corpus. The `/docs-libraries` dashboard lists sources and documents, supports search and previews, and provides registration and refresh controls. Documentation has its own evidence kind and optional worker; `solemd infra up` restores it without changing code navigation. Use Context7 or primary web docs when local coverage is missing, stale, unavailable, or insufficient, and state why.

atlas.description: ConceptAtlas — the knowledge-graph navigation surface over the SoleMD.Make vault (projects, slides, manuscripts, meetings, claims, sources, datasets and their concept/citation/claim graph). The CONTENT sibling of repowise (which indexes code): use repowise for code, atlas for what you have already written, what it is grounded on, and what to clone. Navigate before authoring; never grep the vault. Primary flow: find(query) for fused semantic+keyword+concept search WITH the graph neighborhood (the 'what do we have on X' entry) -> dossier(seed) for a budgeted, clone-ready scaffold of a new deck/report/manuscript (falls back to the nearest existing material for a net-new seed, mode=search) -> doc(id, fields=true) for one note's reusable frontmatter card. Grounding: evidence(concept) for the sourced backing + a thin_evidence flag, claim(text) for a reusable sourced assertion and everywhere it is asserted, source(citekey) for a paper's provenance (DOI/PMID/Zotero, cited-in, claims it grounds). Also: concept, thread, semantic, keyword, stats, and datasets/dataset/dataset_sql (read-only DuckDB over de-identified extracts). suggest = read-only growth proposals to ratify. The one write is refresh (rebuild+ground the derived store from the vault, server-side). It NEVER edits your notes — authoring new notes/evidence.json is done with the file tools, not this MCP.
